summary: v1.2 regression + new-feature testing. All 14 pre-existing backend tests still pass. 14 new backend tests added (test_v12_features.py) covering groups CRUD, radio-group assignment/unassign cascade, messages (group/private/inbound/invalid), voice (status + PTT SMS-fallback), emergencies (simulate/list/clear + radio.in_emergency flip), repeaters auth + shape, static SETUP.md files, and voice.ambe_hardware_available=false. Frontend UI test verified: login, dashboard, tabs (Ops + Messages), Groups panel with 5 chips + Manage modal + 4 simulate-emergency buttons, injected radio + simulated emergency triggered red banner ('EMERGENCY · 2 ACTIVE'), red roster row highlight, red map marker with 'SOS' label + pulsing ring, bottom-right toast 'EMERGENCY: TEST-UI Radio panic button pressed', banner-X clear worked (2->1 active), Messages tab conversation + group send stored + visible, Setup Guide nav present.

minor.issue: InjectPayload does not accept talkgroup_id, so the auto-assign-group-by-talkgroup code path in record_packet() cannot be exercised via the simulation endpoint (only via real HB master UDP ingest). Consider adding talkgroup_id to InjectPayload for testability.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. ve-dynamic wraps the option's text child in a span. Not blocking (message send works) but pollutes console with hydration errors. Fix: wrap group/radio label with a plain string, e.g. `{`${g.name} · TG ${g.talkgroup_id}`}` on a single expression or add key differently.

ui_bugs.component: Radix DialogContent (Groups manage modal + maybe others)
ui_bugs.issue: A11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby.

action_items: (Optional) Add talkgroup_id to InjectPayload so /api/inject can exercise the auto-group-by-tg path in tests.
(Optional) Fix <span> inside <option> React hydration warning in MessagingPanel.jsx around the group/radio <option> children.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent instances (groups-manage modal) for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_radio uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) then filters out None values EXCEPT for group_id (allowing group_id=None to unset via $set). Works, but silently ignores non-None strings that are empty. Consider using $unset for group_id=None instead of storing None.
Emergency simulate endpoint (/api/emergencies/simulate) is auth=user (not admin). That's fine for a dev helper but may want to gate it in production.

MessageStore.send with target_dmr_id also honors group_id-derived talkgroup (from endpoint). If both are provided, it treats it as private (is_private=True) and ignores talkgroup. Endpoint doesn't reject the ambiguous combination - minor UX issue.
groups.py update() casts talkgroup_id to int if present, but PATCH accepts None keys correctly. Good.
WebSocket handler catches broad Exception; no logging - would help debugging in prod.
seed_data_creation: Test-created radios (TEST-UI dmr_id 7778888, TEST-GRP 41182xx, TEST-EMG 51182xx) cleaned up in each test. Test group TEST_Ambulance_* also deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_v12_features.py covers groups/messages/voice/emergencies/repeaters/static-setup. Backend BASE_URL falls back to preview URL if env not set (pytest env doesn't inherit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Voice/AMBE + real HB master UDP path cannot be exercised in preview (documented in review_request mocked_apis). Frontend WebSocket occasionally shows an initial 'connection closed before established' warning but the app recovers - not a real issue. Two pre-existing 'stale' emergencies exist in DB from earlier iterations (e.g. K7SAR-1), so /emergencies?status_filter=active is non-empty even without new triggers - your tests should key off dmr_id or emergency_id, not count.
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking bugs. All requested v1.2 features verified end-to-end.
